checks: True silence has no invented pulse or spectrum
A sustained signal has no recurring fake beat
Separated real spectral attacks produce separate pulses
Rapid fluctuation respects transient refractory interval
Pause and mute remove pulse and cannot generate new onset
Response zero disables spectral excitation and pulse
High frequencies map to a brighter spectral centroid than bass
Silent spectrum decays rather than retaining a frozen signal
Bad inputs and format changes stay bounded with a stable output buffer
scope: Pure analyser-feature behavior; synthetic inputs are test fixtures, not product music or visual QA.
